props.gloss_en: R' Chanina bar Pappa set against each other: 'I will take back My grain in its time' (Hos 2:11) and 'you shall gather your grain' (Deut 11:14)
here ('you shall gather your grain') -- when Israel does the will of the Omnipresent
there ('I will take back My grain') -- when Israel does not do the will of the Omnipresent

R' Yishmael: conduct yourself with [the words of Torah] in the way of the world -- not, as one might have thought from 'this book of the Torah shall not depart from your mouth' (Josh 1:8), literally as written
the verse: 'and you shall gather your grain' (Deut 11:14) is what teaches the way of the world
R' Shimon ben Yochai: when Israel does the will of the Omnipresent, their work is done by others
as it is said: 'and strangers shall stand and feed your flocks' (Isa 61:5)
when Israel does not do the will of the Omnipresent, their work is done by themselves
as it is said: 'and you shall gather your grain' (Deut 11:14)
and moreover [when Israel does not do His will] the work of others is done by them
as it is said: 'and you shall serve your enemy' (Deut 28:48)
Abaye: many acted in accordance with R' Yishmael, and it went well for them
Abaye: [many acted] in accordance with R' Shimon ben Yochai, and it did not go well for them
Rava to the Rabbanan: I beg you, in the days of Nisan and the days of Tishrei do not appear before me
so that you are not troubled over your food all year
